name: Whisperio
subtitle: AI Dictation, Your Own Keys
promotionalText: Fast, private AI dictation for iPhone, iPad, Mac & Watch. Bring your own API key or run fully offline.
description:
Whisperio turns your voice into clean, formatted text — anywhere you type on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

DICTATE ANYWHERE
Trigger dictation from the Home Screen widget, Control Center, Back Tap, Apple Watch, or a system-wide custom keyboard. Text appears where you're already typing — Messages, Notes, Slack, email, anywhere.

YOUR PROVIDERS, YOUR KEYS
Whisperio doesn't lock you into one AI vendor. Bring your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, or Replicate, or skip the cloud entirely and run transcription on-device with Apple's built-in speech recognition or a downloadable local model. No Whisperio account, no subscription, no markup on API usage — you see exactly what each provider costs you.

AI CLEANUP, ON YOUR TERMS
Raw dictation pastes instantly. When you want it polished, run on-demand AI cleanup — fix grammar, apply a custom instruction, or use a saved template — without waiting on every single word.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Whisperio never reads your screen and never phones home to a Whisperio server. Audio goes straight from your device to the transcription provider you chose — or nowhere at all, if you're running fully offline.

STAYS IN SYNC
Your dictation history syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud, organized into a searchable journal with categories (Work, Personal, Ideas, Messages, Code, To-do) and an optional AI daily digest.

BUILT FOR SPEED
- System-wide custom keyboard with real predictive suggestions
- Home Screen widget and Apple Watch trigger
- Personal dictionary and vocabulary
- Group conversation mode with speaker diarization
- Native Mac app with global hotkeys

Whisperio is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license — you can inspect exactly how it handles your voice and your keys.
